capability: Compose the already reviewed managed Setup recovery diagnosis and execution owners into the thin Distribution Launcher host for an exact RecoveryRequired managed root, without automatic mutation, path inference, a second policy, writer, parser, or process-launch path
searchEvidence: ManagedDistributionLauncherHostServices already constructs the single state store, root probe, version repository, installed-launcher repository path, lifetime handoff, entry coordinator, and Setup experience.

ManagedInstallationRecoveryExperience and ManagedSetupRecoveryExecutionCoordinator are the only Application recovery diagnosis/action owners; FileSystemManagedSetupRecoveryExecution is the only exact Infrastructure mutation adapter.
ManagedLauncherEntryResult already carries the exact ManagedRoot for RecoveryRequired, so the host can bind that typed path without deriving it from state or filenames.
Distribution Launcher currently returns RecoveryRequired with no recovery session; no other production recovery composition or caller exists.

scripts/code_size_policy.py and ADR 0021 are the existing exact descending source-size ratchet owners and must bind the measured composition delta rather than hiding it through mechanical file splitting.
semanticOwner: VersionManagement Application retains recovery policy and explicit-action coordination; Bootstrap only wires the existing ports and exposes a root-bound session for the typed RecoveryRequired entry result
terminalContract: RunAsync remains read-only. SetupRequired exposes only Setup; RecoveryRequired with a non-null exact entry ManagedRoot exposes one recovery session using the existing diagnosis and execution coordinators; healthy and every other outcome expose neither. Recovery never starts automatically and cancellation performs no Execute call. Completing an explicit action reruns the canonical host entry path.

designReview.evidence: The independent recovery architecture review kept production composition as a separate least-authority slice and approved reusing the existing state store, root probe, repository, installed-launcher state, lifetime probe, diagnosis experience and execution coordinator. It rejected automatic recovery, inferred paths, Infrastructure-owned action policy, a second writer lease, and any additional process-start owner.
